clauses.clause: sec. 2: Agriculture, Interior, USTR, FDA and SBA to submit to the President within 90 days a report assessing rules and policies affecting ranchers, with recommendations
sec. 3(a): within 90 days, Interior to determine whether gray and Mexican wolves meet ESA recovery criteria and, if so, begin delisting or downlisting
sec. 3(b): within 90 days, Interior to submit to the President a legislative recommendation to delist or downlist the wolves

sec. 3(c): within 90 days and only upon Interior's determination that recovery criteria are met, Intergovernmental Affairs with Agriculture to engage States on State wolf listings and lethal-take standards
sec. 3(d)-(e): within 90 days, Interior and Agriculture to consider amending depredation-compensation rules and standards; Interior to consider revising lethal-removal criteria
sec. 4: Agriculture to review within 90 days authorities for mandatory country-of-origin labeling of beef and give a summary and economic analysis; may then issue rules or legislative recommendations
sec. 5: each agency head to take appropriate steps so the measures benefit consumers through lower prices
sec. 6(d): costs of publishing the order to be borne by the Department of Agriculture

review.conclusion_reason: YES depends on an unverified current agency source. The original establishes duties but does not independently establish their operation at the cutoff under the project's positive-current-source rule. The supported assessment is OPEN pending a retrievable current implementation source and ending check. Formal status remains only a limited no-ending-found observation: the slice lists no later naming instruments, but the claimed search could not be confirmed.
missed_evidence: The held EO_14425.txt, PDF page 3, section 6(d), adds an omitted operative payment direction: 'The costs for publication of this order shall be borne by the Department of Agriculture.' Its performance or continuing status needs a clause state.

The held text, PDF page 1, makes section 3(c) conditional: 'Upon a determination by the Secretary of the Interior that the ESA recovery criteria has been met'. Generic Agriculture outreach would not alone prove that Interior made this determination or that the specified Intergovernmental Affairs duty was operating.

The held text, PDF page 1, introduces all of section 3 with 'Within 90 days of the date of this order'. This also qualifies sections 3(c)-(e); it is a performance deadline, not evidence of termination.
review.stop_code_verdict: wrong (WEB fits): the slice provides no held agency completion records or current-law evidence, and the result identifies unexamined agency/White House records as the missing sources. Its Federal Register naming search would not establish that submissions were not found in those records. NOT_FOUND is not substantiated.
review.suspected_defect: Possible unsupported promotion of wolf-related clauses to operating: the cited outreach quotation, even if verified, would not establish Interior's determination or implementation of the compensation and lethal-removal consideration duties. No deliberate fabrication can be established from the accessible evidence.

verdicts.reason: The named held Federal Register text confirms the number, date, title, and 91 FR 57765 publication citation.
Section 2 expressly requires the listed officials to submit the report to the President within 90 days; the full paragraph confirms the truncated quotation.
Section 3(a) contains the quoted determination requirement and conditional direction to begin delisting or downlisting.
Section 3(b) expressly requires preparation and submission of the legislative recommendation to the President.
Section 3(c) confirms conditional State engagement; the separately inspected sections 3(d) and 3(e) confirm the consideration requirements, although the supplied quotation covers only 3(c).
Section 4 confirms the quoted review requirement and its 90-day deadline.
Section 5 directs each agency head to take appropriate steps toward lower consumer prices and specifies no termination date. This confirms the textual duty, not its current operation independently.
The exact GovDelivery URL failed retrieval through both the web tool and a direct request. Neither the quotation nor the bulletin date could be confirmed.
The cited bulletin could not be retrieved; the quotation and its context remain unconfirmed.
The exact Federal Register API URL failed retrieval. The quoted order text does not itself establish the claimed result count or absence of later instruments.

stop_code_verdict: wrong (WEB fits): the slice provides no held agency completion records or current-law evidence, and the result identifies unexamined agency/White House records as the missing sources. Its Federal Register naming search would not establish that submissions were not found in those records. NOT_FOUND is not substantiated.
